body:
N-44 RECALL CHECK, 26 Nov 2026 (lead; the advisor's item 3 after #138): does the plain title gate still take what the server really keeps? Tools: handoff-2026-11-03/scripts/session-26nov/n44_recall.py and n44_arabic_videos.py (run with PYTHONPATH on the server package, NOT with -I, which ignores it: my first run imported the OLD installed code and measured nothing); recorded answers: local/n44-recall/ and local/n44-recall-arabic/ (the latter are now fixtures).

(1) 19 songs of VM 108's library (5 Arabic, 6 imports named by their video title, 8 Latin): the kept video is among the REAL video results for 7 of them (the six 'Live on KEXP' imports and one Arabic title); the new rule ranks it first for all 7, none lost. The other 12 were kept as SONG results (not the plain path). Two songs CHANGED: the OLD rule took 'EMMO - ZEUS (Official Music Vidéo)' for the wanted Arabic title by EMMO MJ (a REAL wrong song of the same artist, B-136 on real data) and the new one refuses it; 'Quatrehuit - ؟?' (a title that is only punctuation, folds to nothing) is refused: the cost already named.

(2) 8 real Arabic searches (64 candidates): the official uploads in Latin titles pass; bilingual FAN uploads ('Fairouz - Kifak Enta | فيروز - كيفك إنت') fail the gate but were also UNDER the bar before (3.0 of 4.0), except 'Fairuz - Kifak Inta with rain' (5.0: a modified version, refused now). **A RECALL LOSS THE FIRST GATE HAD**: Arabic artists' OWN channels write 'Latin | Arabic' titles as a matter of course (Wael Kfoury's), which the old rule took on artist and length and the word-by-word bar refused. FIXED in this PR: a title written twice is the same song when every word left is in the other script AND the upload is on the artist's own (or Topic) channel at the wanted length to the second; real fixtures (8 files, tests/fixtures/ytm/*.videos.json); four mutants of the rule red.

NOT MEASURED: label channels (Rotana and the like) have no artist evidence, so their bilingual uploads need the song path; a library with more Arabic songs than the owner's few. A VM 108 deploy carrying #138 may follow this PR (it touches the YouTube matcher only, not the album matcher).
